title: Point to line to plan to built place
summary: A single dot stretches into a line, the line draws a floor plan, the plan tilts into 3D and extrudes into lit volumes inside a growing site, with figure callouts and two short statements, then rewinds to the line and the wordmark.
use_when: Architecture, real estate, construction or spatial-design products that turn drawings into places
A build-from-nothing story where the object assembles in one continuous camera move
A slow, premium loop for a site hero or showroom screen
Showing 3-4 project figures over a hero object without a UI

look.type_style: thin geometric sans, all caps, wide tracking (~0.2 em), wordmark ~8 % H with a hairline warm-tan rule under it; side caption and statements small caps ~2 % H; figures light sans ~6 % H with tiny tracked caps labels

sfx.event: dot appears and stretches into a line
walls and volumes settle while extruding
streets and neighbour blocks grow around the building
build rewinds to the plan and the line

structure.motion: dot visible from 0.50; line grows both ways to ~25 % W by 1.50, easings.inOutSine ~30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.motion: wordmark fades up 1.75 (one cell, ±0.25 s), holds ~22 fr, fades by 2.77 over ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.motion: strokes draw on in sequence 3.27-5.00 (rooms close at 4.50, inner walls by 5.00), easings.linear per stroke; caption fades in at 3.77, out by 6.25

params.brand: any brand.json: thin display font, fg off-white, accent for the hairline rule, bg black
params.content.name: one-word wordmark, set in tracked caps over the line
params.content.tagline: one short line under the rule at the close
params.content.caption: two-line side caption during the plan draw, <= 5 words
params.content.statements: two short statements in turn over the site, 3 and 2 words
params.content.stats: 4 figures {value, label}, shown two at a time in left/right slots
params.plan: floor-plan geometry: rooms as rectangles with inner wall strokes, extruded heights per room
params.cycles: 1 or 2 build cycles (reference runs the 31 s cycle twice plus a 10 s variant)

notes: One continuous shot: cuts.json has 0 cuts (near-miss at 67.00 is the plan snapping back, not a cut), so every transition is continuous. The 31 s cycle (rows 1-11) repeats at +31.00 s with small differences (larger wordmark, cool interiors, a push-in over the finished site). Times from the 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); fades, stroke speeds and layer durations below 0.25 s are defaults. Spring choices are suggested: overshoot not measurable at 4 fps. Camera scales measured from object widths on the sheets. Audio: no music, no VO; audio.json shows non-music sound events between 0 and 30.7 s and silence after 30.69 s; their kind could not be identified, so all sfx are planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): plan-draw, extrude-build, build-rewind, site-grow, stat-callout.
